title: docs: add Cursor Cloud specific instructions to AGENTS.md
body: ## Summary Adds a `## Cursor Cloud specific instructions` section to `AGENTS.md` with practical setup caveats discovered during environment setup: - **Node 24 PATH override** — the VM's `/exec-daemon/node` (v22) takes precedence over nvm; update script prepends the nvm v24 bin path. - **`.env` from injected secrets** — auto-generated from `DATABASE_URL` and `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` environment variables. - **Dev server startup verification** — how to confirm the dev server is healthy. - **Comment CRUD hello-world** — quick API check that exercises both Neon DB and Vercel Blob integration. ## Evidence of working environment Homepage showing video list from Vercel Blob: ![Homepage video list](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-73085467-ab71-4535-bb8a-e45584a9d33f) Video annotation page (Nadia 12 Mars) with player, timeline, and comments: ![Video annotation page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-4b72aeaa-db29-4411-80c2-c03b214d4b0b)
